data.name: ConnectionLost
data.value: The connection to the database was lost.

data.name: TnsAdminMissing
data.value: TNS aliases need the folder with tnsnames.ora: enter it in the connection or set the TNS_ADMIN environment variable.

data.name: AddressIncomplete
data.value: Incomplete address: service name or SID is missing.

data.name: ActualPlanNoRights
data.value: The actual plan needs read access to V$SQL and V$SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS_ALL – a DBA can grant it: GRANT SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE TO <user> or GRANT SELECT ON V_$SQL / V_$SQL_PLAN_STATISTICS_ALL TO <user>. The estimated plan works without it.

data.name: CursorGone
data.value: Cursor {0} is no longer in the shared pool – try again.
data.comment: {0}: SQL_ID of the statement

data.name: UndoWrittenMeanwhile
data.value: Something else was written in the meantime – ↶ would now undo “{0}”. Choose again.
data.comment: {0}: description of the newest write action, e.g. "UPDATE AUFTRAG" or "KUNDEN: 2 changed"

data.name: WorkspaceReadOnly
data.value: The workspace is read-only – unlock it before writing.

data.name: FlushChanged
data.value: {0} changed
data.comment: Part of a write summary, "KUNDEN: 2 changed, 1 new, 1 deleted"; {0}: number of rows

data.name: FlushInserted
data.value: {0} new
data.comment: Part of a write summary, "KUNDEN: 2 changed, 1 new, 1 deleted"; {0}: number of rows

data.name: FlushDeleted
data.value: {0} deleted
data.comment: Part of a write summary, "KUNDEN: 2 changed, 1 new, 1 deleted"; {0}: number of rows

data.name: NoRowIdReturned
data.value: Oracle did not return a ROWID for the new row.

data.name: ExplainOnlyQueries
data.value: Only queries (SELECT/WITH) can be explained.

data.name: ExplainInReadOnlyTransaction
data.value: Oracle refuses EXPLAIN PLAN in a READ ONLY transaction.

data.name: WriteTransactionOpen
data.value: A write transaction is open.

data.name: ConnectionReadOnly
data.value: The connection is read-only.

data.name: TransactionAlreadyOpen
data.value: A transaction is already open.

data.name: WriteOnlyInTransaction
data.value: Writing is only possible inside a transaction.

data.name: DdlOnlyWithoutTransaction
data.value: DDL only runs without an open transaction – it would commit it implicitly. Commit or discard first.

data.name: DdlTableBusy
data.value: Not started: another session has written to {0} and not committed yet. The DDL would wait for it and could not be cancelled meanwhile. Commit or discard there, then run it again.
data.comment: ALTER TABLE was not run because the table is locked. {0} = table name

data.name: DdlObjectBusy
data.value: Another session holds locks on the object – for example another workspace that has written to the table and not committed yet. Commit or discard there, then run the DDL again. ({0})
data.comment: DDL failed with ORA-00054. {0} = Oracle's message

data.name: LockOnlyInWriteTransaction
data.value: Rows are only locked inside a write transaction.

data.name: NoWriteTransaction
data.value: No write transaction is open.

data.name: NotEditableView
data.value: Views and materialized views are read-only.

data.name: NotEditableNoRowKey
data.value: Without a primary key or ROWID, rows cannot be changed unambiguously.

data.name: NotEditableVirtual
data.value: Virtual column – Oracle computes the value.

data.name: NotEditableIdentity
data.value: Identity column – Oracle assigns the value.

data.name: NotEditablePrimaryKey
data.value: Primary keys can only be changed in new rows.

data.name: NotEditableType
data.value: {0} cannot be edited here.
data.comment: {0}: Oracle data type, e.g. XMLTYPE

data.name: ValueRequired
data.value: {0} cannot be empty (NOT NULL).
data.comment: {0}: column name

data.name: LobExpectsBytes
data.value: {0} expects bytes.
data.comment: {0}: Oracle data type, e.g. BLOB

data.name: LobExpectsText
data.value: {0} expects text.
data.comment: {0}: Oracle data type, e.g. CLOB

data.name: NotADate
data.value: “{0}” is not a date (DD.MM.YYYY [hh:mm[:ss]]).
data.comment: {0}: the text as typed. The input format stays day.month.year in both languages.

data.name: NotATimestamp
data.value: “{0}” is not a timestamp (DD.MM.YYYY hh:mm:ss[,ffffff]).
data.comment: {0}: the text as typed

data.name: NotATimestampWithTimeZone
data.value: “{0}” is not a timestamp with time zone (DD.MM.YYYY hh:mm:ss[,ffffff] [+hh:mm]).
data.comment: {0}: the text as typed

data.name: NotATimeZoneOffset
data.value: “{0}” is not a time zone offset (between -12:00 and +14:00, e.g. +02:00).
data.comment: {0}: the offset part of the text as typed

data.name: NotANumber
data.value: “{0}” is not a number (e.g. 4711 or 12.5).
data.comment: {0}: the text as typed

data.name: NotAHexValue
data.value: “{0}” is not a hex value (e.g. CAFE01).
data.comment: {0}: the text as typed

data.name: TooLongBytes
data.value: Too long: {0} bytes, {1} allowed ({2}).
data.comment: {0}: length of the value; {1}: maximum length; {2}: Oracle data type, e.g. VARCHAR2(20 BYTE)

data.name: TooLongCharacters
data.value: Too long: {0} characters, {1} allowed ({2}).
data.comment: {0}: length of the value; {1}: maximum length; {2}: Oracle data type, e.g. VARCHAR2(20 CHAR)

data.name: WholeNumbersOnly
data.value: {0} only takes whole numbers ({1}).
data.comment: {0}: column name; {1}: Oracle data type, e.g. NUMBER(10)

data.name: TooManyDecimals
data.value: At most {0} decimal places ({1}).
data.comment: {0}: scale of the column; {1}: Oracle data type, e.g. NUMBER(10,2)

data.name: TooManyIntegerDigits
data.value: Too large: at most {0} digits before the decimal point ({1}).
data.comment: {0}: allowed digits before the decimal point; {1}: Oracle data type, e.g. NUMBER(5,2)
